derivation: Cantilever tip: integral_0^L P(L-x)^2/(EI)dx=PL^3/(3EI), integral_0^L P/(kGA)dx=PL/(kGA). Simply supported centre: two halves integral_0^(L/2) P*x^2/(4EI)dx=PL^3/(48EI); shear two halves integral_0^(L/2) P/(4kGA)dx=PL/(4kGA). I/A=h^2/12. Error relative total=r/(1+r).
limitations: Constant 5/6 shear factor is a stipulated elementary model, not universal or exact 3D elasticity. Checks address omitted shear, not all support/local-stress/material errors. Derive load/support-specific terms, not one universal ratio.
